title: The Honey Vault Rescue
story: Deep in the Amberhive crypt, Selvidorne pours thick golden honey into the vault where three beekeeper cubs are hiding on a ledge. The honey rises at 4.5 inches every minute, and the cubs' ledge sits 90 inches above the floor. Mr 6 can chip a drain channel that lowers the level by 1.5 inches per minute while the flood keeps pouring.
question: With the drain open the whole time, how many minutes until the honey reaches the cubs' ledge?
solution: With the drain open, the honey really rises 4.5 - 1.5 = 3 inches each minute.
Mr 6 has 30 minutes — plenty to build a rope ladder and get all three cubs out.
praise: Dividing by a rate was exactly the right instinct — the missing step was subtracting the drain first to find the real rise per minute.
hint: The flood pours in and the drain lets honey out — what is the NET rise each minute before you divide?
victory: Mr 6 hauls the sticky cubs up with 4 minutes to spare, and Selvidorne, drained to a puddle, is bottled and sold as breakfast syrup.
imagePrompt: A vast amber honey flood rising in a candlelit crypt with a slow syrupy monster face forming in it, three small cubs on a high ledge, and a numeral-six knight chiseling a drain channel with glowing determination.
